title: Turnfall - turn based tactical game
author: uwotwot
selftext:
[https://turnfall.com](https://turnfall.com)

(**desktop only for now**) if turn based tactic's with a fire emblem/advance wars flare is something your interested in - feel free to reach out as I am looking for feedback on this early version (still has many bugs)!

1. few things to note - unlike advance wars the focus is on heroes not groups of soldiers.
2. wait for all the assets to load in loader (even during round start some assets my load in first few rounds)
3. not mobile or tablet friendly right now (very early build) play on desktop only full screen
4. campaign is a nice way to learn the game!

Hope you all enjoy the game \^\^

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: Great! What do you plan to do with it?

replies.author: uwotwot
replies.body:
Get it to a point where the gameplay is genuinely fun! (me and friends have been spending hours on multiplayer and jumping on voice call playing) its been great fun but still a few things to iron out \^\^

so ideally:

\- focus on gameplay/multiplayer/ranked  
\- focus on campaign  
\- then can worry about distribution (itch windows version & steam)

in future def thinking of porting a react native version (since its all DOM based) and getting it ready for mobile!

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: That is a good start. Now how to you. plan to incorpoate user feedback into making it fun.

replies.author: uwotwot
replies.body: right now Ive been just taking feedback via messages - I did just create a discord server so people can post suggestion if thats what you are referring too \^\^ (the link should be available on main menu on refresh)

comments.author: Ellasmi
comments.body: Wow this is really cool! Im currently creating my own fire emblem fan game with the help of Ai for the portraits and backgrounds, but Im using a SRPG studio engine for it, but sometimes its very limited. What engine did you used for this?

replies.author: uwotwot
replies.body: Thank you! as far as game engine, this was all custom typescript rendered through DOM (html/css)(no Unity, Unreal, Godot, Phaser, etc.) happy to connect if you would like to know more about the stack \^\^

replies.author: ArmyOfCorgis
replies.body: I'm also building a tactics game! Do you guys wanna connect and talk game design strategies/challenges?

replies.author: uwotwot
replies.body: Nice happy to try it out if its available somewhere \^\^ and Im always down to connect and learn from others!

comments.author: Bal_oney77
comments.body: love the advance wars format! one of my favorite games ever

replies.author: uwotwot
replies.body: Loooved advance wars! Def took inspiration from advance wars, fire emblem, xcom eu ^^

comments.author: Short-Ad1188
comments.body: Looks good. How long did it take? Did ai generate the art?

replies.author: uwotwot
replies.body: Yes all art and media is AI generated \^\^ I had built a ai creative suite before (similar to google flow) that really helps speed things up as far as asset generation

replies.author: Busy-Ad-9681
replies.body: Oh I would love more info about this please, the game looks great
